FLIGHT RESTRICTION IN THE VICINITY OF BANGOR ERRIS, COUNTY MAYO.
TEMPORARY RESTRICTIONS (TEMPORARY RESTRICTIED AREAS) ON THE FLYING 
OF AIRCRAFT AND ROCKETS AS DEFINED IN S.I. NO.25 OF 2023, SHALL 
APPLY IN THE TEMPORARY RESTRICTED AREA (TRA) CONTAINED WITHIN THE 
VOLUME OF AIRSPACE DEFINED BELOW:
LATERAL LIMITS: A CIRCLE RADIUS OF 0.6NM CENTRED ON:
540733.1N 0094659.5W
VERTICAL LIMITS: SFC TO 3100FT AMSL
DURATION: THE PERIOD OF THE RESTRICTION SHALL BE 0000HRS ON FRIDAY 
AUGUST 21ST TO 0000HRS UTC ON SATURDAY NOVEMBER 21ST 2026.
CONTROLLING AUTHORITY: ANDREI LUCA, ENEVATE BV, SCHIEWEG 15R, 2627AN 
DELFT, THE NETHERLANDS,  +31 685358986, A.LUCA(AT)KITEPOWER.NL 
STATE AIRCRAFT, AIRCRAFT OF THE IRISH COASTGUARD SERVICE AND HEMS 
AIRCRAFT OPERATORS EMPLOYED ON AN OPERATIONAL MISSION SHALL BE 
EXEMPT FROM THE RESTRICTION INCLUDING FLIGHTS AUTHORISED BY THE 
CONTROLLING AUTHORITY (ENEVATE BV).
